en: A colorized vintage postcard showing a busy shipyard and dock area with multiple steamships and boats moored and in drydock along a canal. Industrial buildings and workshops line the left side, while smaller houses or offices stand on the right. Numerous flagpoles carry blue and yellow flags. In the distance the canal continues through a wooded landscape. The caption at the top right reads "Motala, Verkstad, Dockan," and a vertical imprint along the right edge credits a local printer in Motala.
